title: The Cursed Pumpkin
summary: Stealth-resource hot-potato game with sealed guesses and an epoch-timed holder reveal. Reviewed November 4, 2026: the public browser still replays the creator’s October 28 four-player Esmeralda game with 23 recorded transaction links. The separate Live game view reports 404 / Substate not found for its recorded component. The cause is not established; the November 2 organizer reset notice asked entrants to republish templates. No replacement deployment was established by these sources. New games use the Python client and testnet bonds; the browser replay is not a new multiplayer match. Timing, pass counts, the host’s first hop, off-chain information and the final revealed holder remain observable. A holder who never reveals causes partial bond refunds. The retained October 29 clip accurately demonstrates the historical replay. MIT source; no wallet access, ownership signing or payments were performed.
cardSummary: Replay a secret hot-potato game and compare public transaction clues with the hidden route of its single pumpkin.
creator: iammzee
